title: Funding and donors — Management & Training Corporation
summary: What public money, grants, donor-advised funds, PAC contributions, lobbying expenditures, investment vehicles, and contract revenues fund or financially connect Management & Training Corporation?

provenance.method: high-recall privatization-network lead enumeration and target materialization

workflow.next_action: Extract IRS Form 990 grants, FEC receipts and disbursements, LD-2/LD-203 filings, state disclosures, and public grant databases.

data.target: Funding and donors — Management & Training Corporation
data.research_question: What public money, grants, donor-advised funds, PAC contributions, lobbying expenditures, investment vehicles, and contract revenues fund or financially connect Management & Training Corporation?
objectives: Extract IRS Form 990 grants, FEC receipts and disbursements, LD-2/LD-203 filings, state disclosures, and public grant databases.
Resolve donor-advised fund intermediaries without assigning the underlying donor unless disclosed.
Separate direct contributions, independent expenditures, grants, investments, contracts, and in-kind support.
hypotheses: Official public records will resolve at least part of the requested network.
The relationship graph will contain materially different edge types that must not be collapsed into a generic influence claim.
out_of_scope: control claims inferred only from funding, attendance, or membership
